audit_note: Run 3 (generated cases, batched): the 12 generated cases were judged in a single blind comparator context that received only contract/readback pairs (no case type, no expectation), on the project's model (deepseek-v4.1-flash). 12/12 detected, 0 missed. This run also drove an operator fix: the original `encoding` operator only changed 'componentwise subset' to 'subset' (not a mismatch in this setting) and the original `direction_flip` produced a self-contradictory gloss; both were corrected (encoding now switches 'S-sorted equivalences' to 'S-sorted relations', a genuine Setoid-vs-relation residual) and the corrected corpus detects 12/12. Run 2 (per-case, hand-authored cases) is retained in the same map for CAL-001..CAL-011.
